title: Free representable sheaf maps are sections
statement: For a site $\mathcal D$ with Grothendieck topology $J$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], an object $U\in\mathcal D$, and an abelian sheaf $I\in\operatorname{Sh}(J,\operatorname{Ab})$, let $\mathbf Z[U]$ be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on the representable $U$. There is a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Sh}(J,\operatorname{Ab})}(\mathbf Z[U],I)\cong I(U)$, sending a morphism to the image of the basis element corresponding to $\operatorname{id}_U$.
